cases.plan_item: Perimeter drain (triage group R2; daily card D07 neighbour); BUG-217
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with BUG-217 in BUG_CARPARK.md (Codex pass 18: expected "the drain on the plan carries its own PD tag (PD1), matching the command line and the record"; seen: the plan repeated "AG" text and no PD tag, prompts said "AGI vertex" and "Place this AGI drain?"). [Accept/Cancel] <Accept>:" and, on Accept, "Perimeter drain PD1 placed". One polyline and one text PD1 are added on layer AGI DRAIN. No prompt says "AGI vertex" or "Place this AGI drain". One U takes both back. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The prompts, the tag counter and the drawn tag text all come from the live command in the real drawing.
not_automated: That the PD1 text is visible and readable on the plan (its height, position and colour) is a Codex look; the case reads that a text PD1 exists on the drain's layer. BUG-236 (move, erase, copy) is R37b. The outlet choice and the Charged / Suspended property are not driven.

Double-click it to change it. Nothing was changed." and "CD command cancelled"; the pipe window never opens). BUG-684 (arcs and closed polylines) is in R39b, BUG-187 and BUG-874 are not driven.
